from_speaker: If OpenAI fails, and CoreWeave fails

our_interpretation: Failure means bankruptcy, insolvency proceedings, or permanent cessation of business. Falling share prices or financial distress alone do not qualify.
Both OpenAI and CoreWeave must fail before the predicted consequences can be assessed.
The Crusoe clause expresses a weaker expectation than the categorical Core Scientific clause.
No deadline or interval between the companies’ failures is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: After documented failures of both OpenAI and CoreWeave, Core Scientific also fails. A subsequent Crusoe failure would support the additional, weaker expectation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After both antecedent failures, a completed restructuring or other decisive resolution establishes that Core Scientific survives the resulting disruption. Temporary survival alone cannot settle an unlimited forecast.
